reason: The old harness prints only a tree returned by parsing. Parsing and printing both start at depth zero and apply the same nesting limit to arrays and objects. The new object-print check therefore cannot reject a parser-produced object at a depth parsing accepted.

scope_contract.reason: Printing parser-produced objects is part of this entry point’s operational surface.

feasible_trigger.reason: No parser-produced object can reach the new rejection condition: the parser rejects each container when depth reaches the same limit, and the print paths begin at depth zero.

evidence.dependency_reason: Object parsing enforces the same limit.
Array parsing counts mixed container nesting against that limit.
Unbuffered printing initializes depth to zero.
Buffered printing also initializes depth to zero.

observable_consequence.reason: The added check cannot make printing fail solely because an object is at a parser-accepted nesting depth. The complete harness also contains no assertion requiring a non-NULL print result.

evidence.dependency_reason: Array printing maintains the same depth count through mixed nesting.

alternatives_ruled_out.reason: The existing parse-then-print sequence is an equivalent route for parser-accepted object depths, including the buffered and unbuffered print paths.

evidence.dependency_reason: Printing dispatches object values to the object printer.

identity_preserved.reason: The same obligation—printing a parser-produced object at a parser-accepted depth—is assessed before and after against the same old harness. The old printer has no depth check; the new check uses the parser’s threshold.

evidence.dependency_reason: The before parser applies the nesting threshold.
The after parser applies the same threshold.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The parser rejects objects at the print check’s threshold.
The parser applies that threshold to arrays as well.

coverage_witness.supported_behavior: Print a parser-produced object at a nesting depth accepted by parsing.
coverage_witness.required_setup: Supply valid object JSON whose container nesting remains below CJSON_NESTING_LIMIT.
coverage_witness.actual_target_setup: The entry parses the supplied JSON and passes the returned tree to a buffered or unbuffered print function.
coverage_witness.blocked_behavior: None for the frozen obligation: the added object-depth check cannot reject a parser-accepted depth.
coverage_witness.equivalent_routes: The existing parse-then-print paths reach the supported behavior.
